legal.title: Privacy Policy
legal.description: How IMG2GRID handles usage data, analytics, support messages, and browser-based image conversion.
intro: Welcome to IMG2GRID ("we", "us", "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you visit img2grid.com, a fan-made Tomodachi Life image converter. Contact us at support@img2grid.com.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
bullets: Usage data: Pages visited, browser type, device information, referral sources, approximate location, and timestamps.
Technical logs: IP address, error logs, and security events needed to operate the site.
Support communications: Messages you send to our support email.

sections.heading: 2. Image Processing
paragraphs: The converter runs in your browser for previewing pixel grids, palettes, and guide canvases. Uploaded files used in the browser tool are processed locally by the page script unless a future feature clearly states otherwise.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Information
bullets: Understand which converter features and guide topics are useful to visitors.
Protect the site from abuse, spam, and security issues.
Respond to corrections, feedback, and support requests.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and Analytics
paragraphs: We may use necessary cookies and analytics tools to understand site performance and visitor behavior. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with hosting, analytics, security, or legal service providers only when needed to operate the website or comply with law.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain usage logs and support communications only as long as reasonably needed for site operation, security, analytics, and legal compliance.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict certain personal information. To make a request, contact support@img2grid.com.

sections.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: IMG2GRID is a general audience tool site. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

sections.heading: 9. External Links
paragraphs: The site may link to external resources. External websites have their own privacy practices, and we are not responsible for their policies.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy by changing the effective date and content on this page.
